response.overview: A window into a short film about a new citizen’s transformative experience of the Dublin landscape and cultural imagination featuring how Irish lore, humour-wit, myth, literature and poetry work in this regard. Combined with current social realities, immersed in the snarls, tussles, tugs and delights around reckonings with a new home country, the film aims to chew over how we  find the ties that bind, abdicate either/or divides and negotiate the emotional architecture of multiple bonds and fissures.Presenting specific sites as fulcrums of meaning, wit and contradiction (the Liffey, 40 foot, Tallaght, Dublin bay) it distills these encounters to see how they coalesce/collide in dis/connecting to a new country.
response.title: Treading Softly in Dublin
